bullets.text: unhurried. like the second cup, not the first.
clear and cold at okunoin. duck carried a 🌀 and a line about old karma surfacing. a cedar root is still lifting the same stone.
swapping the summer duvet for the winter one. the corners never agree on which corner they are.
found a receipt from march in a coat pocket. two onigiri and a battery. no memory of the battery.
